summary: Authored the exact nine assigned employer-neutral skill identities as immutable deterministic 2.5D SVG geometry definitions. Each definition has one reusable master geometry, the frozen projection and orientation, the canonical eight palette slots, a complete tier-0 exterior identity, interior-only higher-tier linework, and literal primary/master SHA-256 values recomputed through the existing canonical serializer. The nine selected concepts were visually inspected as topology and art-direction references only. File-local lint, strict TypeScript, schema validation, exact assignment closure, forbidden-reference audit, and hash recomputation pass. No integration, placement, promotion, build, aggregate test, or external handoff is claimed.

shared_contract.instance_reuse_model: one canonical definition per skill; employer instances may supply only palette and placement
shared_contract.tier_0_policy: complete exterior silhouette, primary masses, required connections, footprint-defining faces, and roofline
shared_contract.higher_tier_policy: interior linework only; no footprint, primary mass, connection, roofline, orientation, or primary-path changes
shared_contract.tier_2_attachment_rule: one small line-only attachment per definition, wholly inside the accepted silhouette; viewport activation limits remain later scene-integration ownership

limitations: The promoted concept PNGs were used only as non-runtime identity, topology, and art-direction references; their pixels are not path, coordinate, footprint, collision, or hash authority.
The nine tier-2 line attachments are illustrative only. Later scene integration owns the accepted per-focus and per-viewport visibility cap; this lane adds no activation behavior.
G4 did not add placement, registry integration, scene integration, interactions, CSS, tests, dependencies, factual copy, or 3D work.
This report intentionally omits its own byte count and SHA-256. Root or the Director must freeze those values in an external handoff envelope after finalization.
